items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Easier than Sarah or Ella. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, easier, because that’s hard to do that, Sarah or Ella.

ctx.x: Easier than Sarah. Easier than Sarah or Ella.

Oh yeah, easier, because that’s hard to do that, Sarah or Ella. It takes some doing. But Lady Day, her style was a little more fitting to people that could do it. She could do all of it. It wasn’t no problem about her doing that, because she could sing ballads, she could sing the blues, and she could make the shout, like that. She was just a all-around singer. So there was no problem for her to get to certain things. All what had to happen is she would go to some place, and somebody would tell her, just tell her…
What about its demands on you, though? Or – as a trio, or as accompanists? That’s . . .
